prompt:
Style: traditional paper-cut silhouette art (Scherenschnitt) as in 1920s silhouette animation films and shadow theatre, made as a background for a side-view adventure game. Everything is cut with a fine knife from flat matte paper in exactly four flat tones and laid flat on top of each other: pure white #FFFFFF paper for the empty sky and the empty sea, light grey #BDBDBD paper for the far distance, dark grey #6E6E6E paper for the middle distance, pure black #000000 paper for the foreground. Every shape is one solid flat tone with crisp knife-cut edges: no gradients, no shading, no texture, no outlines, no highlights, no drop shadows, no blur, no glow. Depth is shown only by the tone of the paper: the farther, the lighter. Fine filigree knife-cut details inside the dark shapes, cut right through so that the white shows: roof slates as rows of tiny scallops, the joints of the stones in the cottage walls as thin cut lines, plank gaps in the jetty and the boats, hoops of the barrels and planks of the crates as thin slits, the rope coil as a spiral slit, delicate railings and rigging as fine threads of paper. The outer silhouettes stay bold, simple and readable. Not a photograph, not a 3D render, not a painting, not a postcard, no colour at all.
Location: the small harbour of Lornholm, a fictional island in a northern sea, at dusk. A stone quay with a short wooden jetty runs along the lower third of the picture. Two small wooden fishing boats are moored at the jetty. On a rocky headland on the right stands a white lighthouse with one red band, its lamp lit. On the left a small stone harbour-master's cottage with a lit window and a smoking chimney. On the quay: two barrels, a stack of crates, a coil of rope and an iron lantern on a wooden post. Calm sea, low clouds, a band of orange light at the horizon, the first stars.
Composition: strict side view like a shadow-theatre stage, a flat horizontal ground line, no perspective. The black stone quay is a flat band whose top edge is a straight horizontal line at 72 % of the image height; below that line everything down to the bottom edge is solid black paper with only a few stone joints cut close to its top edge. The flat sea horizon is at 56 % of the image height. Black foreground, standing on the quay: the harbour-master's cottage at the left edge, filling the left 22 % of the width, its roof ridge at about 30 % of the image height, the chimney against open sky; its window panes and the glass of the lantern are cut-out openings (they are lit in the game). The iron lantern hangs from a curved bracket on a wooden post standing at about 66 % of the width, the lantern at about 42 % of the image height. Two barrels, a stack of crates and a coil of rope stand together on the right of the quay from 80 % to 100 % of the width. Between 24 % and 62 % of the width the quay is completely empty, only the flat ground line, as a walking path. Dark grey middle distance, behind the quay in the sea: the short wooden jetty on thin posts from 22 % to 55 % of the width with its deck at about 63 % of the image height, and the two small fishing boats with masts and furled sails floating beside the jetty, each boat a separate shape that touches neither the jetty nor the other boat; the rocky headland rising from the sea on the right from 70 % to 100 % of the width, the lighthouse on it at about 86 % of the width as a dark grey silhouette with its top at about 14 % of the image height, its red band shown as a thin cut slit, its lamp room a small cut-out opening without any beam. Light grey far distance: a low, gently rolling island coast along the horizon from 25 % to 75 % of the width, and three long thin strips of low cloud high in the sky that touch nothing. The sky and the sea are empty white paper: no waves, no stars, no moon, no birds, no smoke, no beam, no glow (sea, sky colours, stars, smoke, birds and lights are added by the game). Keep plain white sky above the lighthouse and the chimney, and solid black along the bottom edge (the image will be cropped to 16:9).
Leave the quay in the foreground free of characters: it is a game background, characters are added later as separate sprites.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.

Character parts sheet for a jointed paper-cut shadow puppet (Scherenschnitt) for a side-view game, in the manner of 1920s silhouette animation films: the badger courier cut with a fine knife from flat matte black paper, solid pure black #000000 shapes on a plain pure white #FFFFFF background, nothing else. The outer silhouette is bold and readable and carries the character: the peaked cap with its short visor, the round ear, the long pointed snout with the nose, the stout belly, the short legs with big paws and claws, the long knitted scarf with fringes, the satchel, the parcel. Inner details are delicate filigree knife cuts right through the black paper, so that the white shows through: the eye as a small almond-shaped hole, the white stripe of the face and the white cheek as cut-out bands with fine black bridges, the button on the cap as a tiny round hole, the edge of the vest, its pocket flaps and buttons as thin cut lines and tiny holes, the rolled-up sleeve as thin cut lines, the knit of the scarf as rows of tiny slits and its fringe as separate thin strips, the string and bow of the parcel as fine cut lines, a few fur notches along the edges. The cut-outs stay small; the figure stays mostly solid black. No grey, no colour, no gradients, no shading, no outlines in another colour, no shadows, no paper texture. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, not a painting.
The two reference images: the first shows only the arrangement of the sheet and the division of the character into pieces, the second shows the costume and the proportions of the character. Take nothing of their colours or their painting style.
Layout of the sheet: the badger courier seen exactly from the side, facing right. Left third of the image: the complete assembled puppet standing upright in a neutral pose, both feet flat on one baseline, the near leg slightly in front of the far leg, the near arm holding the parcel against the side of the body, the loose ends of the scarf hanging down his back. Right two thirds of the image: the same puppet taken apart into separate pieces, each piece complete and at exactly the same scale as the assembled figure, laid out with clear empty white space between all pieces; no piece touches or overlaps another. The pieces: (1) the body: head with cap and ear, the scarf wrapped around the neck, the torso with vest, satchel strap and satchel, the belly and the short tail, WITHOUT arms and WITHOUT legs, cut complete where arms and legs attach. (2) the near arm: sleeve, forearm and paw holding the parcel tied with string, its top end rounded like a puppet joint. (3) the far arm: the same arm without the parcel, hanging straight down, its top end rounded. (4) the near leg: a short, stout leg with a large paw with claws, seen from the side, standing straight, the top of the leg rounded like a puppet joint. (5) the far leg: the same leg. (6) the two loose ends of the knitted scarf with their fringes, hanging straight down, separate from each other. No labels, no arrows, no guide lines, no frames, no pins or rivets drawn.
The badger courier: an original mascot character, a stout, short-legged badger with a broad black-and-white striped face, wearing a dark green peaked cap with a brass button, a dark green vest with pockets over a cream shirt with rolled-up sleeves, a long red knitted scarf, a brown leather satchel on a shoulder strap, and a brown paper parcel tied with string under one arm.
No text, letters, numbers, signatures, watermarks or logos anywhere in the image. No real places, brands, franchises or recognisable characters from existing games or films.
Image format: landscape 3:2.
